description:
SourceDefinition is one kind.json source entry: a path plus optional
 `schema` — a JSON Schema file describing the source's shape. No
 `schema` means raw content, as before. Declaring one makes the
 source's content a contract the runner enforces at render time: reads
 and writes go through the parsed value, not the raw string.

path.description: Resolved relative to the enclosing kind.json.

schema.description:
JSON Schema file for this source's shape, resolved relative to the
 enclosing kind.json. Omit for no declared shape.

title: Source Definition
